chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Vaudeville versus film acting
summary: In vaudeville you follow other acts and do just an act, while in pictures you play a part.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Wait a second, you were doing vaudeville at this time?
When you say that you performed in vaudeville at this time --
All along we've been performing in vaudeville.
But from the time that you came back from Toronto, you continued in different vaudeville --
Can you describe a little bit what that experience is like, performing in vaudeville? How is it different from, for example, performing in films or performing in cabaret?
You follow acts on a program of vaudeville and in the pictures you do -- you play a part. See, that's the difference. You don't play no part on the vaudeville stage. You just do an act.
